cards.name: 字源_疾
cards.scene: Two simple side-by-side panels. Left: a sick child lying in bed with a thermometer and a cold towel on the forehead. Right: a single arrow flying very fast through the air with long speed lines. Gentle, not scary, no injuries shown.

cards.name: 字源_死
cards.scene: Two simple side-by-side panels in a calm, gentle cartoon style. Left: a small neat pile of old white bones on the ground (no skull, nothing scary). Right: a person kneeling quietly beside the bones with head bowed in sadness. Soft colors, peaceful mood.

cards.name: 字源_集
cards.scene: Many small birds flying in and perching together on the branches of one tree, crowding close side by side, as if gathering for a meeting.
